title: HackMeet
tagline: our platform presents gateway to make NFT gated Meetings for specific  NFT holders
description:
we have designed a meeting platform which has NFT gated we used encreption of lit protocol with some access control conditions and we used huddle to integrigate room meeting feature
so that when ever a user trys to get into meet he will be verified through our lit nodes to decrept the data of his room details
how_its_made:
we made it by adding an NFT gated feature and then we tried to integrigate access control conditions for that in which we check the ownership of NFTS and then we allow him to join meet 
we tried to integrate push chat feature but we ran into lot of errors and we used huddle to fullfill the remaining part
